data.title: 水原千鹤 · 水族馆观景廊的回眸牵手
data.description: 在水族馆干燥的浅灰瓷砖观景廊里，中性白色顶灯照亮千鹤的侧颜。厚玻璃与金属窗框清楚隔开游客和水槽，鱼群只在玻璃后游动。她回过身来，轻握住你的手，温柔地示意你跟上。
data.action: 站在玻璃外的干燥观景廊回头，轻握画外同伴的手
data.location: 水族馆干燥观景走廊，巨大玻璃水族箱外侧
data.lighting: neutral white LED gallery lighting, balanced daylight, natural skin tones
data.promptProse: In the public aquarium viewing corridor, Chizuru stands on dry light-grey tiles outside the fish tanks. Neutral white LED ceiling lights keep her skin and clothes naturally colored, while fish swim behind clearly framed glass panels. She turns back with a gentle smile and holds the viewer's hand.
data.animaCaption: She stands on dry light-grey tiles in the public viewing corridor, holding the viewer's hand while looking back. Neutral white LED ceiling lights illuminate her normally colored face and clothes; the fish and blue water remain behind clearly framed glass panels.
